craft_notes: Sthāyin: impurity defined — veiling wish. Rows: willed, nothing-else, thingness. Rejected: moralizing taint — killed: wish, not fault. Read aloud: stark decree.

lines: That is the taint the Highest's veiling-scheme willed —
nothing else at all a thing though;
and lo, by that Highest-willed self alone is earth and all things true.
l4.sanskrit_cite: so 'yaṃ malaḥ parameśvarasya svātmapracchādanecchātaḥ nānyat kiṃcit vastv api ca tatparameśvarecchātmanaiva dharāder api vastutvāt
